messages.app.guard.title: Permission guard
messages.app.guard.off: Off. Turn it on to get a warning when an app asks for a permission, or when you open an app you just installed.
messages.app.guard.on: On. PrivUp will explain permission pop-ups and new apps on this phone.
messages.app.guard.disclosure.title: Before you turn this on
messages.app.guard.disclosure.body: PrivUp uses Android's accessibility service to notice when an app shows a permission pop-up or when you open an app you just installed, and then shows what that permission can do. It only looks at which app it is and which permission it asks for. It does not read your messages, typing or other screens, keeps no history of what you do, and nothing leaves this phone. On the next screen, open PrivUp and turn it on.
messages.guard.permission.title: {app} is asking for {permission}
messages.guard.permission.tip: Only allow it if the app needs this for what you are doing right now. You can choose Don't allow, or Only this time.
messages.guard.new_app.title: You just installed {app}
messages.guard.new_app.none: It does not ask for any risky permission.
messages.guard.rbi: Loan apps are not allowed to take this under RBI rules.
messages.guard.service: Explains permission pop-ups and newly installed apps, in your language. Reads only which app it is and which permission it asks for. Nothing leaves this phone.
messages.permission.contacts.name: your contacts
messages.permission.contacts.risk: It can read every name and number you have saved and upload them. Some loan apps used this to call your family and friends.
messages.permission.location.name: your location
messages.permission.location.risk: It can see where you are, and with background access, where you go all day.
messages.permission.camera.name: the camera
messages.permission.camera.risk: It can take photos and record video while the app is open.
messages.permission.microphone.name: the microphone
messages.permission.microphone.risk: It can record what is said near your phone while the app is open.
messages.permission.sms.name: your SMS messages
messages.permission.sms.risk: It can read your messages, including bank alerts and one-time passwords (OTPs), and send messages from your number.
messages.permission.call_log.name: your call history
messages.permission.call_log.risk: It can see who you call, who calls you, and for how long.
messages.permission.phone.name: phone calls
messages.permission.phone.risk: It can make calls, see your phone number and know when you are on a call.
messages.permission.storage.name: your photos and files
messages.permission.storage.risk: It can open your photos, videos and files, and copy them.
messages.permission.calendar.name: your calendar
messages.permission.calendar.risk: It can read your events and who you meet, and add or change them.
messages.permission.nearby.name: nearby devices
messages.permission.nearby.risk: It can find and connect to devices around you, which can reveal where you are.
messages.permission.notifications.name: notifications
messages.permission.notifications.risk: It can send you notifications. Low risk, but it can be used for ads.
messages.permission.activity.name: your physical activity
messages.permission.activity.risk: It can tell when you walk, run, drive or cycle.
messages.permission.sensors.name: body sensors
messages.permission.sensors.risk: It can read health data such as your heart rate.
